autoComplete.title: Automatic trip completion
autoComplete.explanation: So you never have to touch your phone while driving, each pending trip is marked as completed and paid in cash when the next trip of the same driver or vehicle starts or, at the latest, once its estimated road duration plus a margin has passed. The app only shows an informative notice; corrections are made in "To review", with the vehicle stopped.
autoComplete.startDelay: Wait until the trip starts (minutes, usually 5-10)
autoComplete.defaultDuration: Duration when there is no distance (minutes)
autoComplete.example: Example: a {{duration}} min road trip scheduled at 10:00 would be completed at {{time}}.
autoComplete.invalid: Check the values: wait 0-120 min, final margin 0-240 min, margin 0-100 % and duration 5-1440 min
autoComplete.disabledHint: Disabled: you will have to mark every trip by hand.

tariffs.title: Reference taxi fares by region
tariffs.explanation: Maximum intercity fares on weekday daytime, published by each Spanish region. The price shown is per km travelled: where both the outbound and return legs are charged (closed circuit) it is double the official fare. It is only a guide: if you work as a private hire driver your prices are free and everyone sets their own.
tariffs.loadError: Could not load the reference fares.
tariffs.medianExplanation: The median across regions is {{median}}/km. Rutero suggests a bit more because the suggested price is just distance × price/km: it does not add the flag fall, minimum fare, waiting time or night/holiday surcharges.
